IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects O JOIN sys.schemas S ON O.schema_id = S.schema_id WHERE O.NAME = '[FACT_SATISFACCION]' AND O.TYPE = 'U' AND S.NAME = '[dbo]')
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FACT_SATISFACCION]
	(
	 [ID_FACT_SATISFACCION] int,
	 [IdDIMTIEMPO] int,
	 [ID_DIMPACIENTE] int,
	 [ID_DIMCOMENTARIO] int,
	 [ID_ENCUESTA_MONGO] bigint,
	 [PUNTUACION_GENERAL] int,
	 [SCORE_ATENCION_MEDICA] int,
	 [TIEMPO_ESPERA_MINUTOS] int,
	 [SCORE_TRATO_PERSONAL] int,
	 [SCORE_CONSULTA_DOCTOR] int,
	 [RESOLUCION_DUDAS_VAL] bit,
	 [CANTIDAD_ENCUESTAS] int,
	 [FECHA_CARGA] datetime2(7),
	 [ID_DIMPATOLOGIA] int
	)
WITH
	(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
	 -- HEAP
	)
GO
